gateB.evidence: 24/24 MuJoCo checks PASS; 0 penetration/sliding/suspension; ankle_roll unfrozen

root_causes: Policy actual forward speed ~0.270 m/s vs cmd 0.4 m/s (67.5% tracking) — best achievable with current gait params
heading_command=True was a breakthrough (fixed yaw drift, improved from 43.8% to 67.5%)
Discriminator saturates (acc=1.0) in all runs — anti-saturation measures (v3-v11) either failed or broke walking
Reward rebalancing (stride/clearance/air_time) degraded rather than improved speed tracking
Longer training (4000-6000 iter) did not improve and sometimes degraded speed tracking
key_findings: v14 (heading_command=True, original rewards, 2000 iter) is the best config: 67.5% tracking, 0 falls, 2401 ep_len, lat_drift 0.22m, yaw 17→3.5°
base_lin_vel (base frame) overestimates forward speed vs world frame when yaw drift exists
heading_command=True reduced yaw drift from 18° to 3.5° and lat_drift from 1.28m to 0.22m
The 85% target requires actual_vx ≥ 0.34 m/s but X1 with cycle_time=1.0 and stride=0.36m achieves ~0.27 m/s max
